name: josmrpy.github.io
description: Some tools that I've made while being bored.

paragraphs: Hello, World! This is the personal portfolio of Josimar Madrigal. I'm a Costa Rican Computer Science enthusiast, technical student, Scout, and builder of projects across programming, accessibility, networking, education, civic participation, and robotics.

The site is a static, responsive, single-page portfolio built with Astro (static output, plain CSS and vanilla JavaScript, no UI framework), with an interactive playground. It is organized into the following sections:
features: Carousel at the top of the page with press coverage, case studies, and recaps of programs I've taken part in (Delfino.cr, Georgetown CIED, the Ministry of Public Education, the Legislative Assembly, the U.S. Embassy,…
Browse with the arrows or the dots. Articles are maintained in src/data/articles.js.
Hero introduction with current highlights and a featured sumobot image.

Current highlights include being a Top 5 National STEM Fair finalist, the developer of Moody, Cisco Networking Academy certification, Stanford Code in Place graduation, and the Youth Ambassadors Program exchange.
Personal background, interests, and motivation for building technology that solves real problems.
